targetTexts.1: Wine is a mocker, strong drink is a brawler, and whoever is led astray by them is not wise.
targetTexts.2: The terror of a king is like the roar of a lion; whoever provokes him forfeits his own life.
targetTexts.3: It is honorable for a man to resolve a dispute, but any fool will quarrel.
targetTexts.4: The slacker does not plow in season; at harvest time he looks, but nothing is there.
targetTexts.5: The intentions of a man’s heart are deep waters, but a man of understanding draws them out.
targetTexts.6: Many a man proclaims his loving devotion, but who can find a trustworthy man?
targetTexts.7: The righteous man walks with integrity; blessed are his children after him.
targetTexts.8: A king who sits on a throne to judge sifts out all evil with his eyes.
targetTexts.9: Who can say, “I have kept my heart pure; I am cleansed from my sin”?
targetTexts.10: Differing weights and unequal measures—both are detestable to the LORD.
targetTexts.11: Even a young man is known by his actions—whether his conduct is pure and upright.
targetTexts.12: Ears that hear and eyes that see—the LORD has made them both.
targetTexts.13: Do not love sleep, or you will grow poor; open your eyes, and you will have plenty of food.
targetTexts.14: “Worthless, worthless!” says the buyer, but on the way out, he gloats.
targetTexts.15: There is an abundance of gold and rubies, but lips of knowledge are a rare treasure.
targetTexts.16: Take the garment of the one who posts security for a stranger; get collateral if it is for a foreigner.
targetTexts.17: Food gained by fraud is sweet to a man, but later his mouth is full of gravel.
targetTexts.18: Set plans by consultation, and wage war under sound guidance.
targetTexts.19: He who reveals secrets is a constant gossip; avoid the one who babbles with his lips.
targetTexts.20: Whoever curses his father or mother, his lamp will be extinguished in deepest darkness.
targetTexts.21: An inheritance gained quickly will not be blessed in the end.
targetTexts.22: Do not say, “I will avenge this evil!” Wait on the LORD, and He will save you.
targetTexts.23: Unequal weights are detestable to the LORD, and dishonest scales are no good.
targetTexts.24: A man’s steps are from the LORD, so how can anyone understand his own way?
targetTexts.25: It is a trap for a man to dedicate something rashly, only later to reconsider his vows.
targetTexts.26: A wise king separates out the wicked and drives the threshing wheel over them.
targetTexts.27: The spirit of a man is the lamp of the LORD, searching out his inmost being.
targetTexts.28: Loving devotion and faithfulness preserve a king; by these he maintains his throne.
targetTexts.29: The glory of young men is their strength, and gray hair is the splendor of the old.
targetTexts.30: Lashes and wounds scour evil, and beatings cleanse the inmost parts.
